sentence: This project builds artificial intelligence models that read chest X-ray to help screen and diagnose tuberculosis in children.
This project studies compounds from marine cyanobacteria that may help treat cancers that resist drugs.
This project compares twins who had a mild traumatic brain injury with their identical cotwins to find out its long-lasting effects.
This project studies how antibodies aimed at the spike part of betacoronaviruses work, to help design vaccines and antibody therapeutics.
This project uses a microscope to track single transcription factors and find out how they locate their target sites.
This project studies how estradiol and cocaine together change synaptic plasticity in the dorsal striatum, to explain sex differences in behavior.
This project builds a method that uses CRISPR to test what many genes do in mouse lines and human 3D organoid tumor models.
This project supports a program that studies the genetics of Alzheimer's Disease by helping researchers work together and share results.
This project works on making a vaccine platform that shows the immune system many copies of targets for neutralizing antibodies against HIV.
This project tries to find out what causes fever in cancer patients who had chemotherapy, in a setting where HIV infection is common.
This project studies why Plasmodium parasites prefer the youngest human red blood cells and how they adapted to human red blood cells.
This project studies how fentanyl causes airway constriction and respiratory depression, aiming to find treatments that do not reverse the opioid's effect.
This project tries to find and describe embryonic mammary lineage genes that switch back on in breast cancer tumors.
This project improves microscopy tools that help study how the nervous system and senses work.
This project works on diagnostic agents used in molecular imaging to detect neurodegenerative diseases.
This project builds a gene therapy for retinal degeneration linked to mutations in one gene, using mouse models and human retinal organoids.
This project builds Bayesian statistical methods and software to help researchers understand how microbial communities form, stay stable and work.
This project supports the processing and analysis of omics data generated by other projects.
This project tries to find out whether repetitive RNAs that build up in Alzheimer's disease come from aging and add to inflammation.
This project builds an off-the-shelf cell therapy combined with lipid nanoparticles that carry mRNAs, aimed at metastatic pancreatic cancer.
